author: Inside Edition
description: A family trio from Indianapolis has been accused of being real-life tomb raiders, stealing family heirlooms from mausoleums across nine states. Now, after a nationwide manhunt, Drake Millam, his girlfriend Porsche Bancroft, and her mother Angela Garrett have all been arrested. They face multiple charges, including grand theft. Authorities are asking families that discover items missing from a loved one's resting place to contact police.
title: Alleged Tomb-Raiding Family Trio Arrested

author: Inside Edition
description: The man suspected of terrorizing the Center City neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania while wearing a "Chucky" Halloween mask has been identified. Police are looking for 22-year-old Zymire Hughes. Police say a man wearing the mask menaced several people, chasing one woman and asking her if she was "ready to die." Cops say Hughes may no longer be in the area, adding that he has ties to both Nevada and California.
title: Philly Police Identify 'Chucky' Mask Suspect

author: Inside Edition
description: Touching video captured a double amputee Marine Corps veteran named Tony Mullis who stopped on a busy Georgia highway after spotting a United States flag lying on the ground. Mullis lost his legs in an explosion during his second tour in Afghanistan. The disabled servicemember can be seen walking up the roadway on his prosthetic legs to save Old Glory. Mullis spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Double Amputee Marine Veteran Rescues Stars And Stripes From Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: A man begged for help to get out of a burning car just moments after cops say he was evading them. The Montgomery County Sheriff's Office in Texas released this video of the incident. Deputies were responding to a call for theft at a local Walmart and when they arrived they say the suspect got into a car and fled the scene. Deputies say they chased his vehicle, and the driver lost control. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputies Pull Man From Fiery Car After They Say He Crashed While Evading Arrest

author: Inside Edition
description: It's front-page news on both sides of the pond: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are moving back to the United Kingdom. But questions are swirling around their move. Where will the family live? What are Prince William and Kate Middleton thinking? And will the British public want them back? Inside Edition's Jim Moret is near Harry and Meghan's soon-to-be-former home in Montecito, California with the latest.
title: Questions Swirl Around Harry And Meghan's Return To U.K.

author: Inside Edition
description: There were cheers for Lindsay Clancy as she arrived at court today. The accused killer was greeted by a throng of supporters wearing pink to show their solidarity. Clancy has admitted to killing her three children in what she says was a moment of postpartum psychosis; the prosecutor in the case says that Clancy planned the killings. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports that many women are showing her sympathy.
title: Lindsay Clancy Greeted By Crowd Of Supporters Wearing Pink
